tools.name: get_fleet_action_brief
tools.description: Return the top 20 MOT, tax, insurance, service and open maintenance actions across up to 500 non-archived vehicles. Compliance actions include overdue dates and the next 30 days; all open maintenance remains visible, with dates beyond 30 days classified as open. Larger fleets examine the first 500 n

tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.description: Search owned vehicles with exact open-maintenance counts and earliest maintenance dates. Returns at most the requested limit, not a total match count. Narrow the query if the limit is reached. Read-only.

tools.name: get_vehicle_action_detail
tools.description: Return up to 20 actions and the latest 20 reminder records for one owned vehicle. These lists are not exhaustive; open_maintenance_count is the exact open-maintenance total. Read-only.
